targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfMinute(event_time) AS time, countIf(event_type='JOB_COMPLETED') AS completed FROM chronos.chronos_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(event_time) AS time, countIf(event_type='JOB_FAILED') AS failed, countIf(event_type='JOB_TIMEOUT') AS timeout, countIf(event_type='JOB_RETRY_SCHEDULED') AS retry FROM chronos.chronos_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(event_time) AS time, quantileTDigest(0.95)(toFloat64(JSONExtractUInt(payload,'duration_ms'))) AS p95 FROM chronos.chronos_events WHERE event_type='JOB_COMPLETED' AND $__timeFilter(event_time) AND JSONExtractUInt(payload,'duration_ms')>0 GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
SELECT event_type, count() AS c FROM chronos.chronos_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY event_type ORDER BY c DESC
SELECT worker_id, countIf(event_type='JOB_COMPLETED') AS completed FROM chronos.chronos_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND worker_id!='' GROUP BY worker_id ORDER BY completed DESC LIMIT 20
